integrity: The algebraic proof and an exact-rational finite-degree verifier support the stated claim; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: A sharp classification of a published sufficient early-invasion screening score in the degree-based annealed SIS model, not an exact epidemic reproduction number, finite-network realization, or observed outbreak probability. Primary literature supplies the base formula; priority for its new double-turning consequence is provisional.
title: Two separated epidemic-screening degree bands under density-dependent migration
